models.summary: Ideogram 在 2026-10-22 推出 Ideogram Vector。产品页写：用文本提示生成可编辑 SVG，或把现有图转成可以缩放、再改颜色和单个形状的矢量。官方帖称文本提示能出带平滑渐变和清晰字形的可编辑 SVG，也可以把图转成可缩放矢量。产品页的接口是 POST /v2/svg/generate/ideogram-vector-1（提示，参考图可选）和 POST /v2/svg/vectorize/ideogram-vector-1（不写提示，直接转图）。价目按产品页，单位美元每张：文生矢量 Low 0.13、Medium 0.16、High 0.20；带参考图时 Low 和 Medium 不变，High 为 0.32。图生矢量 0.10。这些数字是产品页所写，本库没有下单。本库没有调用 API，也没有在 Ideogram 里生成过 SVG。
models.summaryEn: Ideogram introduced Ideogram Vector on 2026-10-22. The product page says a text prompt produces an editable SVG, or an existing image becomes a vector you can scale and then recolor or edit shape by shape. The official post says a text prompt can produce an editable SVG with smooth gradients and sharp typography, and that an image can become a scalable vector. The page lists POST /v2/svg/generate/ideogram-vector-1 (prompt, references optional) and POST /v2/svg/vectorize/ideogram-vector-1 (no prompt, convert the image). Prices on the product page, USD per SVG: text to vector is 0.13 low, 0.16 medium, and 0.20 high; with references, low and medium stay the same and high is 0.32. Image to vector is 0.10. Those numbers are what the product page writes; this library did not place an order. This library did not call the API and did not generate an SVG in Ideogram.

models.summary: Recursive Flint 是 Recursive 的开放权重编码模型，Apache 2.0。模型卡写总参数 39.8B、每 token 激活约 2.5B（含输出头；激活主体约 2.2B），并写四舍五入的叫法是 40B-A2.5B。博文把规模写成 40B 总参、每 token 2.5B。博文称在 M4 Pro MacBook Pro 上短上下文超过 125 tok/s，在 64GB NVIDIA RTX Spark 上超过 150 tok/s。上下文有两套说法：模型卡的文档化配置是 262,144 token；博文写最多 512k，并建议编码任务留在 256k 以内。模型卡自报 Terminal-Bench 2.1 为 54.9%，SWE-bench Pro v2 为 89.7%，SWE-bench Verified 为 74.2%，本库没有复跑。权重有 BF16（模型卡写下载大约 80 GB）、MLX INT4（卡上写大约 22.6 GB）和 INT4 卡指向的 GGUF。博文写兼容 llama.cpp、Ollama、Unsloth、LM Studio、vLLM、SGLang，并发布推理引擎 rec。本库没有下载，也没有跑。
models.summaryEn: Recursive Flint is Recursive’s open-weight coding model under Apache 2.0. The model card says 39.8B total parameters and about 2.5B active per token, including the output head, with the active body around 2.2B, and gives 40B-A2.5B as the rounded name. The blog rounds this to 40B total and 2.5B per token. The blog says more than 125 tok/s on an M4 Pro MacBook Pro and more than 150 tok/s on a 64GB NVIDIA RTX Spark, at short contexts. Context has two wordings: the card’s documented configuration is 262,144 tokens; the blog says up to 512k and recommends staying within 256k for coding. The card reports 54.9% on Terminal-Bench 2.1, 89.7% on SWE-bench Pro v2, and 74.2% on SWE-bench Verified. This library did not re-run them. Weights include BF16 (the card says the download is about 80 GB), MLX INT4 (the card says about 22.6 GB), and the GGUF the INT4 card points to. The blog lists llama.cpp, Ollama, Unsloth, LM Studio, vLLM, and SGLang, and ships the rec inference engine. Nothing was downloaded or run here.

models.summaryEn: Fibo 2.0 from Bria is an 8B open-weight image model with editing and text-to-image in one set of weights. The model card says it is trained only on licensed data and controlled with VGL structured JSON. Dev is the full base; the card says text-to-image uses 50 steps and guidance 5.0. Edit Turbo is distilled from it for editing only, in 4 steps at guidance 1.0, with masked edits and up to four reference images. The weight pages say non-commercial use is CC BY-NC 4.0 and commercial use needs a separate agreement with Bria. The card dates an Artificial Analysis rank of number 1 in open-weights image editing and number 2 in open-weights text-to-image to 2026-10-20. That is the vendor’s claim; this library did not open the leaderboard. The docs page has no separate calendar launch date. The Dev repo was created 2026-10-18 and Edit Turbo 2026-10-19. fal’s edit and generate pages both say 0.04 dollars per image. Bria’s own pricing page stayed on a spinner, so no second price was visible. The card also names ComfyUI nodes and a Hugging Face Space. No image was generated here.

models.titleEn: Krea 3: Krea’s new image model, in Fast and Ultra
models.summary: Krea 在 2026-10-15 的发布文里推出 Krea 3，写作新的图像编辑模型：按话说改哪里、留哪里，也能直接文生图。发布文称多数编辑在 8 秒内返回、原生 2K，2K 每张 0.06 美元、1K 每张 0.03 美元，一次最多 6 张参考图；产品页现在的标题是比 Nano Banana Pro 快 4 倍，并写它已是应用里的默认图像模型。API 把思考分成 fast、high、ultra。fast 是默认；fast 和 high 不需要 beta。ultra 要 Max 及以上，输出固定 2K，必须带参考图，不带图的请求会按 fast 跑、按 fast 计费，文档写一次可能要几分钟、最长大约 10 分钟。10 月 20 日官方 X 帖称 Ultra 排进图像榜前 4、只被 OpenAI 的模型超过，Fast 把速度和质量的曲线往前推。同一天的官方博客把 Arena、Artificial Analysis、Design Arena 分开写，并写明三块榜不是同一个名次。这些时间和名次都是厂商说法。适合要批量改产品图、又在意单张时间和价钱的人。本库没有登录，没有出过一张图。
models.summaryEn: Krea introduced Krea 3 on 15 October 2026 as its new image-editing model: you say what should change and what should stay, and it can also generate from text. The launch post says most edits return in under 8 seconds at native 2K, at $0.06 per image at 2K and $0.03 at 1K, with up to 6 reference images. The product page’s current headline says it is 4× faster than Nano Banana Pro, and the guide says it is now the default image model in the app. The API splits thinking into fast, high, and ultra. Fast is the default. Fast and high do not need beta. Ultra requires Max or above, always outputs 2K, needs a reference image, and a text-only ultra request runs and bills as fast. The docs say a run can take minutes, up to about 10. On 20 October the official X post said Ultra ranks in the top 4 of image arenas, passed only by OpenAI models, and that Fast pushes the speed-quality curve. The same day’s blog keeps Arena, Artificial Analysis, and Design Arena separate and says they are not one rank. The times and the ranks are vendor claims. Useful when you edit product shots in volume and care about time and price per image. This library did not sign in and did not generate an image.

The comparison table lists Nano Banana Pro at 33 seconds and $0.135, and GPT Image 2 at 90 seconds and $0.22, and says the times are Krea’s own medians from 24 September to 1 October. The product-page headline says 4× faster than Nano Banana Pro.

highlights.textEn: API docs: fast is the default; fast and high do not need beta. Ultra requires Max or above, is always 2K, and a request with no reference image runs and bills as fast. A job can take minutes; the docs say up to about 10. The 8 seconds are the launch post’s ordinary edits, not Ultra.

models.summary: Mistral 在 2026-10-20 发布 Voxtral 3：一组语音模型和一个语音代理 SDK，把听、想、调用工具和说串进一条实时流程。新闻点名的模型有 Voxtral Small Transcribe 3（转录、说话人分离、关键词偏置，官方称覆盖 50 多种语言）、Voxtral Mini Transcribe 3（新闻写 4B 参数，批量每分钟 0.0035 美元）、Voxtral Mini Transcribe Realtime 3，以及 Voxtral Mini TTS 3。文档四页都标着 2026-10-20、Public Preview。新闻写实时模型在 35 种以上语言里低于 500 毫秒；实时模型文档写延迟可以在 80 毫秒到 2400 毫秒之间调，每分钟 0.008 美元。TTS 也有两套说法：新闻写 35 种以上语言、50 种以上方言，模型文档写支持 9 种语言、首包大约 90 毫秒、每百万字符 13 美元。语音代理 API 的价格表写，推理用 Mistral Small 4 时每分钟 0.04 美元，换别的推理模型每分钟 0.08 美元。新闻写可以走 Mistral 的 API，也可以自部署；文档没有写开源许可，也没有写权重下载。适合要做电话或网页里的语音代理、又要欧区或自建的人。本库没有登录 Studio，没有点 Take the call，没有调 API。
models.summaryEn: On 20 October 2026 Mistral released Voxtral 3: a family of speech models and a voice-agent SDK that puts listening, reasoning, tool calls, and speaking on one realtime stream. The news post names Voxtral Small Transcribe 3 (transcription, diarization, and context biasing, which it says covers 50+ languages), Voxtral Mini Transcribe 3 (the news says 4B parameters, $0.0035 per minute in batch), Voxtral Mini Transcribe Realtime 3, and Voxtral Mini TTS 3. All four doc pages are dated 20 October 2026 and marked Public Preview. The news says the realtime model is under 500 ms in 35+ languages; the realtime model page says latency is configurable from 80 ms to 2,400 ms, at $0.008 per minute. TTS has two wordings: the news says 35+ languages and 50+ dialects, the model page says 9 languages, about 90 ms to first audio, and $13 per million characters. The voice-agent price table says $0.04 per minute when reasoning uses Mistral Small 4, and $0.08 per minute with another reasoning model. The news says you can use Mistral’s API or self-deploy. The docs do not state an open-source license or a weights download. Useful for phone or web voice agents that need an EU endpoint or your own infrastructure. This library did not sign in to Studio, did not press Take the call, and did not call the API.

highlights.text: 官方称：Small Transcribe 3 做 50 多种语言的转录和说话人分离，新闻写它超过 Whisper、Scribe v2 和 Gemini 3.5 Transcribe。Mini 批量版新闻写是 4B，每分钟 0.0035 美元。两张文档都标 Public Preview，上下文 32k，Small 每分钟 0.004 美元。分数没有复跑。
highlights.textEn: Vendor claim: Small Transcribe 3 covers transcription and diarization in 50+ languages, and the news says it beats Whisper, Scribe v2, and Gemini 3.5 Transcribe. The news says the Mini batch model is 4B at $0.0035 per minute. Both doc pages say Public Preview and a 32k context; Small is $0.004 per minute. Scores were not re-run.

highlights.text: 实时转录有两套官方说法。新闻写 35 种以上语言、低于 500 毫秒。模型文档写延迟可在 80 毫秒到 2400 毫秒之间调，每分钟 0.008 美元，并带轮次检测、偏置和说话人分离。本库没有对着干。
highlights.textEn: Realtime transcription has two official wordings. The news says 35+ languages and under 500 ms. The model page says latency is configurable from 80 ms to 2,400 ms, at $0.008 per minute, with end-of-turn detection, biasing, and diarization. This library did not reconcile them.

highlights.text: TTS 也对不上。新闻写 Mini TTS 3 支持 35 种以上语言、50 种以上方言，Pro Voice 用大约 30 分钟音频。模型文档的标题是 Voxtral TTS 3，写支持 9 种语言、首包大约 90 毫秒、34 个情绪标签，每百万字符 13 美元。
highlights.textEn: TTS does not match across pages. The news says Mini TTS 3 supports 35+ languages and 50+ dialects, and that Pro Voice uses about 30 minutes of audio. The model page is titled Voxtral TTS 3 and says 9 languages, about 90 ms to first audio, 34 emotion tags, and $13 per million characters.

highlights.text: 新闻价格表：语音代理配 Mistral Small 4 为每分钟 0.04 美元，换别的推理模型每分钟 0.08 美元。开头写欧盟托管或自部署，文末又写 API 有欧洲、美国和全球端点。许可和权重都没写，未核实。
highlights.textEn: The news price table lists the voice agent at $0.04 per minute with Mistral Small 4 and $0.08 per minute with another reasoning model. The opening says an EU-hosted API or self-deployment; the pricing section later says European, US, and global endpoints. No license and no weights are stated. Unverified.

models.qualityNote: 语言数、延迟和“超过某某模型”都是 Mistral 新闻或文档里的说法，本库没有复跑，也没有调 API。新闻和 TTS 文档的语言数不一致，实时模型的延迟说法也不一致，两条都留着。四张模型文档的页眉写 Public Preview 和 Premier；Premier 指什么，页面没有解释，未核实。没有看到开源许可或权重下载，自部署写成联系团队，不要当成已经公开权重。本库没有登录，没有点新闻页上的 Take the call。
models.qualityNoteEn: Language counts, latency, and “beats model X” are claims from Mistral’s news post or docs. This library did not re-run them and did not call the API. The news post and the TTS doc disagree on language count, and the realtime latency wordings disagree too; both are kept. The four model pages are labeled Public Preview and Premier. The page does not say what Premier means, so that is unverified. No open-source license or weights download appears. Self-deployment is written as talking to the team, so this is not a public-weights release. This library did not sign in and did not press Take the call on the news page.

models.titleEn: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017: a minor V4.1-Flash update with MIT weights, plus the open DeepInfer engine
models.summary: DeepSeek 在 2026-10-17 发布 V4.1-Flash 的小版本更新 V4.1-Flash-1017，网页、App 和 API 同步上线：API 模型名仍是 `deepseek-flash`，旧名 `deepseek-v4-flash` 等也转到它。官方称基准更高、完成任务更快、输出更短，在性能和成本上是「帕累托改进」；Hugging Face 模型卡对比表里 DeepSWE v1.1 从 74.2 到 77.0，Terminal-Bench 4.0 从 31.2 到 42.3，HLE（不用工具）从 36.8 到 42.6。权重在 Hugging Face 和 ModelScope 以 MIT 许可放出，模型卡写这次没有附 Jinja 对话模板，改用仓库里的 Python 编码参考实现，另发 Rust 写的 deepseek-recipe 处理提示格式。价格页写 1M 上下文、最长输出 384K、支持视觉，高峰时段每百万 token 输入 0.30 美元（缓存命中 0.006）、输出 1.20 美元，非高峰减半。10 月 20 日 DeepSeek 又开源了自家推理框架 DeepInfer（Apache-2.0），默认就跑这个权重，但只支持 NVIDIA SM100 和华为昇腾 950，且不含 KV 缓存系统和预填充/解码拆分这些完整服务所需的部分。Artificial Analysis 给它智能指数 45，在 121 个模型里排第 2。分数都是厂商或第三方的说法，本库没有调 API，也没有跑权重。
models.summaryEn: On 17 October 2026 DeepSeek shipped V4.1-Flash-1017, a minor update to V4.1-Flash, on the web, app and API at once: the API model name is still `deepseek-flash`, and legacy names such as `deepseek-v4-flash` route to it. DeepSeek claims higher benchmarks, faster task completion and shorter outputs, a Pareto improvement in performance and cost; the Hugging Face model card table shows DeepSWE v1.1 going from 74.2 to 77.0, Terminal-Bench 4.0 from 31.2 to 42.3, and HLE without tools from 36.8 to 42.6. Weights are on Hugging Face and ModelScope under MIT. The model card says there is no Jinja chat template this time; instead the repo has a Python reference encoder, and the separate Rust deepseek-recipe handles prompt formatting. The pricing page lists a 1M context, up to 384K output and vision support, with peak prices per million tokens of $0.30 input ($0.006 cache hit) and $1.20 output, halved off-peak. On 20 October DeepSeek also open-sourced its in-house inference engine DeepInfer (Apache-2.0), which defaults to these weights but only supports NVIDIA SM100 and Huawei Ascend 950 and leaves out the KV cache system and prefill/decode disaggregation a full service needs. Artificial Analysis gives it an Intelligence Index of 45, 2nd of 121 models. Scores are vendor or third-party claims; this library did not call the API or run the weights.

models.summary: MiniMax 在 2026-10-19 发布 M3.1 Flash，官方称此前匿名上线、处理过 200 万亿以上 token 的 Space Bunny 就是它的早期版本。博客写它在复杂 Agent 任务、电脑操作、编程和网络安全上都有进步，在线推理快将近三倍，Agent 任务的总使用成本比上一代低 70%。API 统一价：每百万 token 输入 0.15 美元、输出 0.60 美元、缓存输入 0.015 美元。文档的模型列表写 MiniMax-M3.1-Flash 是多模态编程模型，1M 上下文，思考深度可调。官方给出的分数有 DeepSWE v1.1 73.7%、OSWorld V2 61.7、Agents’ Last Exam 29.6、BankerToolBench 76.2、CyberGym 82%，日常输出可到每秒 200 个 token 以上、中位数 170 以上。现在可以通过 MiniMax API、M Plan 订阅和 MiniMax Code 使用；博客写权重稍后发布，官方 X 帖写 10 月 23 日放出。这些分数和速度都是厂商说法。适合要大量跑 Agent、又在意单价的人。本库没有调用 API。
models.summaryEn: MiniMax released M3.1 Flash on 19 October 2026 and says Space Bunny, which ran anonymously and processed more than 200 trillion tokens, was an early version of it. The blog claims gains in complex agent tasks, computer use, coding, and cybersecurity, online inference nearly three times faster, and agent-task usage costs 70% lower than its predecessor. Flat API pricing per million tokens is $0.15 input, $0.60 output, and $0.015 cached input. The docs model list describes MiniMax-M3.1-Flash as a multimodal coding model with a 1M context window and tunable thinking depth. Vendor scores include DeepSWE v1.1 73.7%, OSWorld V2 61.7, Agents’ Last Exam 29.6, BankerToolBench 76.2, and CyberGym 82%, with everyday output above 200 tokens per second and a median above 170. It is available through the MiniMax API, the M Plan subscription, and MiniMax Code; the blog says weights will come later, and the official X post says 23 October. Scores and speeds are vendor claims. Useful if you run many agent tasks and care about unit price. This library did not call the API.

models.summary: Mistral 在 2026-10-15 发布 Timestral，官方称这是他们的第一组时间序列基础模型。新闻页写四个尺寸：5M、28M、123M、209M，上下文 32768 个时间步，输出 21 个分位数，可以带多变量目标、只在过去已知的协变量，以及未来已知的协变量。规格表写许可是 Modified MIT，可以在本地、VPC 或隔离环境里跑。官方称 209M 在 GIFT-Eval、TIME、fev-bench 的预训练零样本模型里排第一，并用更少的参数超过先前最好结果；28M 在 GIFT-Eval 和 TIME 上超过大约四倍大的 Chronos-2；在 8 线程 CPU 上，用三周的 15 分钟数据预测未来一天，5M 约 10 毫秒、209M 约 140 毫秒。这些名次和耗时都是厂商说法。仓库里的代码是 Apache-2.0。四套权重在 Hugging Face，每份 LICENSE 都是 Modified MIT，并写全球合并月收入超过 2000 万美元的公司需要另谈商业许可。新闻页写技术报告稍后发布。适合要做概率预测、又能接受许可门槛和未复核榜单的人。本库没有下载权重，也没有跑预测。
models.summaryEn: On 15 October 2026 Mistral released Timestral, which it calls its first family of time-series foundation models. The news post lists four sizes, 5M, 28M, 123M, and 209M, a context of 32,768 time steps, and 21 quantile outputs, with multivariate targets plus past-only and known-future covariates. The spec table says the licence is Modified MIT and that it can run on-prem, in a VPC, or air-gapped. Mistral says the 209M model ranks first among pretrained zero-shot models on GIFT-Eval, TIME, and fev-bench, and beats the previous best with fewer parameters; that the 28M model beats Chronos-2, about four times larger, on GIFT-Eval and TIME; and that on an 8-thread CPU, forecasting one day ahead from three weeks of 15-minute history takes about 10 ms at 5M and about 140 ms at 209M. Those ranks and timings are vendor claims. The code in the repository is Apache-2.0. The four weight repos on Hugging Face each carry a Modified MIT LICENSE, which says a company whose global consolidated monthly revenue exceeded $20 million in the preceding month needs a separate commercial licence. The news post says a technical report will follow. Useful for probabilistic forecasts if you can accept the licence limit and unchecked leaderboards. This library did not download the weights or run a forecast.

highlights.textEn: Vendor claim: four sizes (5M, 28M, 123M, 209M), context of 32,768 steps, 21 quantiles, multivariate targets, and two kinds of covariates.

highlights.text: 官方称：209M 在 GIFT-Eval、TIME、fev-bench 的预训练零样本条目里排第一，并已把结果提交到 GIFT-Eval 和 TIME 榜。本库没有打开这些榜。
highlights.textEn: Vendor claim: 209M ranks first among pretrained zero-shot entries on GIFT-Eval, TIME, and fev-bench, and the results were submitted to the GIFT-Eval and TIME boards. This library did not open those boards.

highlights.text: 官方称：8 线程 CPU 上，用三周 15 分钟数据预测一天，5M 约 10 毫秒，209M 约 140 毫秒。本库没有复测。
highlights.textEn: Vendor claim: on an 8-thread CPU, one day ahead from three weeks of 15-minute history takes about 10 ms at 5M and about 140 ms at 209M. Not re-timed here.

models.summaryEn: MOSS-Image from OpenMOSS is a 5B-parameter DiT text-to-image model. The project page and README introduced Base and SFT on 2026-10-16: SFT is Base fine-tuned on curated data. This library did not download the weights or generate an image. The technical report downloaded, and this library did not read it.

models.summaryEn: Black Forest Labs released FLUX 3 Image Klein on 2026-10-15: a 5.6B open-weight image model for text-to-image, instruction edits, and up to 10 reference images. The blog says it shares several capabilities with the full FLUX 3 Image model: native output up to 4K, pixel-perfect editing, and bounding boxes that place an element or confine an edit to one region. There are two weight sets: a distilled one for low-latency generation, and Base for fine-tuning and LoRA. The docs table lists the distilled model at 16 steps and CFG 1, and Base at 50 steps and CFG 3.5. The docs say it fits on consumer GPUs, down to an RTX 3090. The text encoder is Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct. The model card says the 5.6B count is the image transformer only, the encoder is separate, and that encoder is Apache-2.0. The vendor repeatedly says not to send a short prompt as typed: run a prompt upsampler first. The model card calls that upsampler another 9B model, repo flux-3-image-klein-pup. The API name is flux-3-image-klein. The blog says pricing starts at $0.009 per 1K image. The docs price table lists resolutions separately: $0.008 at 768, $0.009 at 1K, up to $0.036 at 4K, with text-to-image and editing at the same price. The license is the FLUX Kommunity License. The blog says individuals and companies with annual revenue under $5M may use it commercially for free; larger organizations need a commercial license or the API. The model card phrases the bar as Qualifying Users with less than US$5M in gross annualized revenue. Good when you want to generate and edit on your own machine and will expand the prompt first. This library did not download the weights, did not run them locally, and did not call the API.

The headline change is Intelligent UI: instead of text only, the model decides whether to add charts, buttons, forms, maps, or interactive diagrams, so a breakdown of a 7-speed bike becomes something you tap through, and it can build a savings calculator or bill splitter on the spot. OpenAI says this runs on a library of native, streamable components plus a compiler, and that the model was trained to make layout and interaction choices, including when plain text is enough. Paid tiers (Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise) get GPT-6 Sol; Free and Go get GPT-6 Luna. Paid rollout starts 10-07 and expands to Free the next day. OpenAI also says GPT-6 can start answering while it keeps thinking, with Instant starting 44% sooner on average for web-search questions. Models in Work and Codex are unchanged.

sources.label: OpenAI：GPT‑6 and Intelligent UI for everyone
sources.labelEn: OpenAI: GPT‑6 and Intelligent UI for everyone

highlights.text: Intelligent UI 是什么：回答里可以有图、可点的按钮、表单、图表和能操作的小工具。比较类问题可能并排放，原理类可能给一张能拖动参数的示意图，简单问题仍然只回一段字。这对做设计的人值得看：聊天界面开始由模型自己排版。
highlights.textEn: What Intelligent UI is: answers can contain graphics, tappable buttons, forms, charts, and small working tools. A comparison may sit side by side, an explanation may become a diagram you can adjust, and a simple question still gets a paragraph. Worth a look for designers: the chat interface is now laid out by the model itself.

highlights.text: 官方说的做法：做了一套能流式显示的原生组件库，再加一个编译器，让界面边生成边出现；训练时专门评估模型做出的界面清不清楚、有没有用、完不完整。官方也承认模型的设计判断还要继续改进。
highlights.textEn: How OpenAI says it works: a library of native, streamable components plus a compiler so the interface appears while it is generated; training evaluated the interfaces for clarity, usefulness, and completeness. OpenAI also says the model's design judgment still needs work.

highlights.text: 谁用哪个：Plus、Pro、Business、Enterprise 用 GPT-6 Sol，Free 和 Go 用 GPT-6 Luna，两者都针对日常对话调过。只改聊天页，Work 和 Codex 不变。企业版是否可用看管理员设置。
highlights.textEn: Who gets what: Plus, Pro, Business, and Enterprise get GPT-6 Sol; Free and Go get GPT-6 Luna, both tuned for everyday conversation. Chat only; Work and Codex are unchanged. Enterprise depends on admin settings.

highlights.text: 官方自测，本库未复跑：联网问题上 GPT-6 Instant 平均比 GPT-5.6 Instant 早 44% 开始回答；内部日常任务评测里，GPT-6 Extra High 开始回答的时间和 GPT-5.6 Medium 差不多，总分高于 GPT-5.6 Extra High。
highlights.textEn: Vendor tests, not re-run here: for web-search questions GPT-6 Instant starts answering 44% sooner on average than GPT-5.6 Instant; in an internal everyday-task eval, GPT-6 Extra High starts answering about as fast as GPT-5.6 Medium while scoring above GPT-5.6 Extra High.

models.title: Claude Haiku 5.5：Anthropic 最便宜、最快的小模型，价格约降四分之三
models.titleEn: Claude Haiku 5.5: Anthropic's cheapest, fastest small model, about 75% cheaper to run
models.summary: Anthropic 2026-10-07 发布 Claude Haiku 5.5，定位是量大、怕贵、要快的活：摘要、分类、数据库查询、在线客服、操作浏览器，或者给 Opus 5.5、Sonnet 5.5 当写代码时的小帮手。官方说平均跑起来比 Haiku 4.5 便宜约 75%。价格按每百万 token 算，提示词在 10 万 token 以内时输入 0.10 美元、输出 0.50 美元，超过 10 万时是 0.50 和 2.50。这是第一款能调「思考力度」的 Haiku。同一天 Sonnet 5.5 的缓存读取降价一半，Max 和 Team 订阅也开始送每月 API 额度。平台模型名 claude-haiku-5-5，各大云平台都能用。
models.summaryEn: Anthropic released Claude Haiku 5.5 on 2026-10-07 for high-volume, cost- and speed-sensitive work: summaries, classification, database queries, live customer support, browser use, or helping Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5 as a coding subagent. Anthropic says it costs about 75% less to run than Haiku 4.5 on average. Per million tokens, prompts up to 100K are $0.10 input and $0.50 output; over 100K, $0.50 and $2.50. It is the first Haiku with an adjustable effort setting. The same day, Sonnet 5.5 cache reads were halved and Max and Team subscriptions got a monthly API credit. Platform model id claude-haiku-5-5, available on the major clouds.

models.name: Strands Decider 2B
models.title: Strands Decider 2B：一个小的开源决策模型，只做选择题和打分
models.titleEn: Strands Decider 2B: a small open decision model that picks an option or gives a score
models.summary: Strands Decider 2B 是 Strands Agents 放出的一个小决策模型。它不写文章。你给它一段现状和几个允许的答案，它为每个答案打一个概率，也可以按一个分数尺打分。仓库写它大约 19 亿参数，基于 Qwen3.5-2B 改来，拿掉了原来用来生成文字的那一层，换上一个大约一百万参数的小头。代码和权重以 Apache-2.0 发布，可以在自己的 CPU 或显卡上跑。官博是 2026-10-01，仓库现在指向的参考版本是 v21，更早的 v19 仍在。本库没有安装，也没有复跑仓库里的分数。
models.summaryEn: Strands Decider 2B is a small decision model from Strands Agents. It does not write prose. You give it a situation and the answers you allow, and it returns a probability for each one, or a score on a scale. The repo says it has about 1.9 billion parameters, starts from Qwen3.5-2B, removes the layer that used to generate text, and adds a small head of about a million parameters. Code and weights are Apache-2.0, and it can run on your own CPU or GPU. The blog is dated 2026-10-01. The repo’s reference version now is v21, and the earlier v19 is still published. This library did not install it and did not re-run the repo’s scores.

sources.label: Strands 官博：Introducing Strands Decider 2B
sources.by: Marc Brooker, Mike Chambers, Fabio Nonato de Paula

sources.label: Hugging Face：当前参考权重 v21
sources.labelEn: Hugging Face: current reference weights, v21

highlights.text: 它是决策模型：不自由写字。你给现状，再给允许的答案。问题有三种，仓库用 noul（是或否）、choice（多选一）和 score（按分数尺打分）。一次前向就把这些答案的概率算出来。仓库写参数量约 19 亿，躯干是 Qwen3.5-2B-Base，原来的语言模型头被拿掉，换成约一百万参数的指针头，再用 rank-16 的 LoRA 微调。LoRA 是只训练一小部分新增权重的做法。
highlights.textEn: It is a decision model: it does not write free text. You provide a situation and the answers you allow. The repo’s three question types are noul (yes or no), choice (one of several), and score (a point on a scale). One forward pass produces the probabilities. The repo says about 1.9 billion parameters. The torso is Qwen3.5-2B-Base, the old language-model head is removed, a pointer head of about a million parameters replaces it, and a rank-16 LoRA adapts the torso. LoRA means only a small set of added weights is trained.

highlights.text: 怎么试（仓库写的命令，本库没跑过）：pip install strands-decider，然后 strands-decider ask，模型名写 StrandsAgents/strands-decider-2B-hobson-v21。也可以在本机 serve。仓库写它能在 CPU、苹果芯片 Mac 或一块消费级显卡上跑。许可 Apache-2.0。
highlights.textEn: How to try, as the repo writes it (not run here): pip install strands-decider, then strands-decider ask with the model id StrandsAgents/strands-decider-2B-hobson-v21. You can also serve it locally. The repo says it runs on CPU, an Apple-silicon Mac, or a consumer GPU. License Apache-2.0.

highlights.text: 仓库自测，本库未复跑，也不把它当成排名。README 的表：JevBench 公开集 231 题，v21 准确率 0.762（176/231），v19 为 0.723（167/231）。同一张表写，六次种子的平均和 v19 配方几乎一样，单次相差大约 10 题以内就算没有分出胜负。延迟列在 v19：RTX 3090 中位 115 ms。官博 10 月 1 日还有一套“在 2B 档第几名”的说法，本卡不转述，因为仓库后来的表自己提醒小差距不可靠。
highlights.textEn: Repo self-test, not re-run here, and not treated as a ranking. The README table: on the 231-task public JevBench set, v21 accuracy is 0.762 (176/231) and v19 is 0.723 (167/231). The same table says a six-seed average of the v21 recipe and the v19 recipe land in the same place, and a gap under about 10 tasks between two single runs is unresolved. The latency column is on v19: median 115 ms on an RTX 3090. The October 1 blog also has a “place in the 2B class” claim. This card does not repeat it, because the repo’s later table says small gaps are not reliable.

models.name: EmbeddingGemma 2
models.title: EmbeddingGemma 2：把文字、图片、声音和视频收成同一套向量的小模型
models.titleEn: EmbeddingGemma 2: a small model that turns text, images, audio, and video into one vector space
models.summary: EmbeddingGemma 2 是 Google DeepMind 在 2026-10-06 发布的开源嵌入模型。嵌入是一串数字，用来表示一段文字、一张图或一段声音的意思，方便按意思搜索，而不是按关键词硬对。这一版把文字（含代码）、图片、视频和声音放进同一个 768 维的空间。模型卡写总参数 7.4 亿，其中文字部分约 2.7 亿，视觉编码器 1.7 亿，音频编码器 3 亿，可以只加载用得到的那一部分。许可页标题是 Apache License 2.0。它面向手机和笔记本上的本地搜索。模型卡里的测试分是 Google 自己报的，本库没有复跑，也没有下载权重。
models.summaryEn: EmbeddingGemma 2 is an open embedding model Google DeepMind released on 2026-10-06. An embedding is a list of numbers that stands for the meaning of a passage, a picture, or a sound, so you can search by meaning rather than by exact keywords. This version puts text (including code), images, video, and audio in one 768-dimension space. The model card says 740 million parameters in total: about 270 million for text, a 170 million vision encoder, and a 300 million audio encoder, and you can load only the part you need. The license page is titled Apache License 2.0. It is aimed at search on a phone or laptop. Scores on the model card are Google’s own. This library did not re-run them and did not download the weights.

sources.label: Google 官博：EmbeddingGemma 2
sources.by: Sahil Dua, Henrique Schechter Vera, Google DeepMind

highlights.text: 模型卡写：总参数 7.4 亿。文字骨干 1.3 亿加嵌入层 1.4 亿，合起来约 2.7 亿；视觉编码器 1.7 亿，音频编码器 3 亿。输出默认 768 维，也可以截成 512、256 或 128 维，用来少占存储。上下文窗口 8192 token。输入可以是文字、图片、视频、声音，以及它们的组合。
highlights.textEn: The model card says 740 million parameters total. The text side is a 130 million backbone plus a 140 million embedder, about 270 million together. The vision encoder is 170 million and the audio encoder is 300 million. The default output is 768 dimensions, and it can be cut to 512, 256, or 128 to store less. The context window is 8,192 tokens. Inputs can be text, images, video, audio, and combinations of those.

highlights.text: 模型卡上的对比分（官方数字，本库未复跑）：代码检索 MTEB Code 的 NDCG@10，EmbeddingGemma 2 是 78.68，上一版是 68.76。多语言文本 MTEB 的平均分是 61.36，上一版是 61.15。模型卡正文另写代码任务相对上一版大约提高 14%。这两处是同一张表和同一页的说法。
highlights.textEn: Comparison scores on the model card (vendor numbers, not re-run here): on MTEB Code, NDCG@10 is 78.68 for EmbeddingGemma 2 and 68.76 for the previous version. Multilingual text MTEB mean is 61.36 versus 61.15. The card’s prose also says code tasks improved by about 14% versus the previous version. Those are the table and the prose on the same page.

highlights.text: 怎么拿（官方渠道，本库没下载）：权重在 Hugging Face 的 google/embeddinggemma-2。文档在 ai.google.dev 的 EmbeddingGemma 页。模型卡写可以用 transformers、sentence-transformers 等常见库加载，也面向设备端。官博还写了在手机上的内存占用和能塞进多少分钟音频，那些设备数字没有写进模型卡的规格表，本卡不另抄一份。
highlights.textEn: Where to get it (official channels, not downloaded here): weights are at google/embeddinggemma-2 on Hugging Face. Docs are the EmbeddingGemma page on ai.google.dev. The model card says it loads with common libraries such as transformers and sentence-transformers, and that it is meant for devices. The blog also states phone memory and how many minutes of audio fit. Those device figures are not in the model card’s spec table, so this card does not copy a second set.

models.summary: Nano Banana 2.1 是 Google 在 2026 年 10 月 6 日（北京时间 10 月 7 日凌晨）发布的出图和改图模型，是 Nano Banana 2 的升级版。适合要做海报、信息图、商品图、角色设定，并且需要反复修改的设计师和内容创作者。Google 在 X 上说它全面超过自家之前的图片模型，进步最明显的是三件事：版式设计、用遮罩改图（先圈出一块区域，只改这一块），以及同一个人物或商品在多张图里保持一致。普通用户可以在 Gemini App 里试（官方模型卡把它列为发布渠道，正在陆续上线）；开发者可以在 Google AI Studio 里试，或用 API 调用 gemini-nano-banana-2.1，API 没有免费档。下面的对比分数和价格都是 Google 自己公布的，本库没有实际出图、没有复跑对比。
models.summaryEn: Nano Banana 2.1 is Google’s image generation and editing model, released on 6 October 2026 (early 7 October Beijing time) as an upgrade to Nano Banana 2. It suits designers and content creators who make posters, infographics, product shots, or character sheets and need to iterate. Google’s X post says it beats the company’s previous image models across the board, with the biggest gains in visual design, mask-based editing (outline an area and change only that part), and keeping the same person or product consistent across images. Regular users can try it in the Gemini app (listed as a launch channel on the model card, rolling out); developers can try it in Google AI Studio or call gemini-nano-banana-2.1 through the API, which has no free tier. The comparison scores and prices below are Google’s own; this library did not generate images or re-run any comparison.

highlights.text: 官方称（X 帖与模型卡）：这一版主要强在三处。一是版式设计，海报、信息图这种要把大字标题、照片和小标签排在一起的图更像样；二是遮罩或涂鸦改图，圈出一块或在图上画几笔，只改那一块；三是主体一致，同一个人物或商品放进多张图里还是同一个样子。宣传短片里能看到一张户外越野跑海报（大字标题、圆形照片、坐标和标签排版）、一只挂着水珠的甲虫特写和一组干花微距。这些是 Google 自己挑的样片，不代表每次出图都这样。
highlights.textEn: Vendor claim (X post and model card): the release focuses on three things. Visual design: posters and infographics that mix big headlines, photos, and small labels come out better. Mask or doodle editing: outline an area or scribble on it, and only that part changes. Subject consistency: the same person or product looks the same across images. The promo clip shows a trail-running poster (bold headline, circular photo, coordinates and label layout), a dew-covered beetle close-up, and dried-flower macros. These are samples Google picked; they do not mean every result looks like this.

highlights.text: 官方开发者文档写的具体变化：出图分 1K、2K、4K 三档，默认 1K；修好了超宽、超长比例（1:4、4:1、1:8、8:1）在 2K 和 4K 下出现的拼接痕迹；图里的文字和信息图排版更准；一次最多放 14 张参考图，其中最多 4 个角色保持长相一致、最多 10 个物品保持外观；可以先用 Google 网页和图片搜索查资料再画；「思考」程度可选 minimal、medium（默认）、high，也就是让模型先想多少再动笔。输入可以是文字、图片、视频和 PDF。
highlights.textEn: Specific changes in the developer docs: output at 1K, 2K, or 4K (1K by default); fixed seam artifacts on very wide or tall ratios (1:4, 4:1, 1:8, 8:1) at 2K and 4K; more accurate text and infographic layout; up to 14 reference images in one request, keeping up to 4 characters and up to 10 objects consistent; can look things up with Google Web and Image Search before drawing; a Thinking setting of minimal, medium (default), or high, i.e. how much the model plans before drawing. Inputs can be text, images, video, and PDF.

highlights.text: 官方模型卡的对比分（找人两两比较哪张更好，再算出相对分，越高越好，只在这张表里互相比较有意义；本库未复跑）：开「思考」时，总体偏好 1050，Nano Banana 2 是 990，Nano Banana Pro 是 935；信息图设计 1048，对比 961 和 912；遮罩或涂鸦改图 1049，对比 965 和 927；多角色一致 1106，对比 978 和 1011。不开「思考」时分数低一些，例如总体偏好 1015。
highlights.textEn: Model-card comparison scores (people pick the better image in pairs, then a relative score is computed; higher is better and it only means something within this table; not re-run here). With Thinking on: overall preference 1050 vs 990 for Nano Banana 2 and 935 for Nano Banana Pro; infographic design 1048 vs 961 and 912; mask or doodle editing 1049 vs 965 and 927; multi-character consistency 1106 vs 978 and 1011. Scores are lower with Thinking off, e.g. 1015 for overall preference.

highlights.text: 怎么试（官方渠道）：模型卡列出的上线渠道有 Gemini App、Google AI Studio、Gemini API、Google 搜索的 AI 模式、Google Ads、Google Flow 和 Google Stitch。设计师最直接的是 Gemini App 和 Flow；要接进自己工具的，在 AI Studio 先试再看出图指南调 API。官方价格页（撰写时）：API 只有付费档，按张折算 1K 约 0.0336 美元、2K 约 0.0504 美元、4K 约 0.113 美元，批量模式约半价。有些第三方文章把 4K 写成 0.0756 美元，与官方价格页不符，以官方为准。
highlights.textEn: How to try (official channels): the model card lists the Gemini app, Google AI Studio, the Gemini API, AI Mode in Google Search, Google Ads, Google Flow, and Google Stitch. For designers the Gemini app and Flow are the most direct; to wire it into your own tools, try it in AI Studio first, then follow the image generation guide. Official pricing at write time: the API is paid only, roughly $0.0336 per 1K image, $0.0504 per 2K, and $0.113 per 4K, with Batch about half. Some third-party articles list 4K at $0.0756, which does not match the official pricing page; go by the official page.

highlights.text: 边界（官方模型卡自己写的不足）：小字容易糊，1K 档尤其明显，长段落、整页文字也不行；输入图和输出图里的人物不一定完全一致；遮罩或涂鸦改图有时只听了一半，涂鸦痕迹可能留在图上；改图时偶尔沿用原图的姿势；有时分不清左右；3D 空间和事实准确性仍有限。要印刷级清晰小字的物料，别直接用 1K 出图交付。旧版 gemini-3.1-flash-image 已在 API 上标为弃用，官方更新日志撰写时写「还没定关停日期」。
highlights.textEn: Limits (from the model card itself): small text often blurs, especially at 1K, and long paragraphs or full pages do not work well; people in the input and output images are not always consistent; masked or doodle edits sometimes follow only part of the instruction, and scribbles can remain; edits occasionally keep the original pose; left and right sometimes get mixed up; 3D reasoning and factual accuracy are still limited. For print work that needs crisp small text, do not ship 1K output as is. The older gemini-3.1-flash-image is marked deprecated on the API; at write time the release notes say no shutdown date has been announced.

models.qualityNote: 价格以官方价格页为准（4K 约 0.113 美元/张）。没有找到 blog.google 上的发布博文，所以官方来源是 X 帖、模型卡和开发者文档。Gemini App 是否已在某个账号里切到 2.1，本库没有登录确认。本库没有实际出图、没有调用 API、没有复跑模型卡评分；遮罩改图、14 张参考图、搜索查资料等功能都没有实测。预览是 X 帖宣传短片（原片 800×800）按 2 倍速转成 3:2 动图 WebP，样片由 Google 挑选。
models.qualityNoteEn: This library leans AI × design, and this is an update to Google’s main image model with layout design and editing as headline features. The release notes mark it GA on 6 October and say the older gemini-3.1-flash-image is deprecated with no shutdown date announced (S5 Labs and others reported 29 October, which does not match the official page’s current wording, so it is not used). Prices follow the official pricing page (about $0.113 per 4K image). No launch post was found on blog.google, so the official sources are the X post, the model card, and developer docs. Whether a given Gemini app account has switched to 2.1 was not checked (no sign-in). models.summary: Beam 是 Reflection 在 2026 年 10 月 5 日公开的开源权重模型，给要写代码、做推理、让编程助手干活的人用。它是稀疏混合专家：参数一共 5010 亿，每次真正计算时只用其中 230 亿。现在还不能下载。官网写它还在做最后一轮安全测试（专门找它会不会被带去干不该干的事），眼下只能到平台页登记提前试用；权重、技术报告、模型卡和给开发者的配套，都说这个月晚些时候才放，并打算用 Apache 2.0。页面表格里的分数是厂商自己报的，这里没有复跑。
models.summaryEn: Beam is Reflection’s open-weight model, announced on 5 October 2026, for people who write code, reason through problems, or hand work to a coding agent. It is a sparse mixture-of-experts model: 501 billion parameters in total, with 23 billion active on each step. It is not downloadable yet. The site says it is still in final safety testing (checking whether it can be talked into doing something it should not), and that early access is a signup only. Weights, the technical report, the model card, and the developer extras are promised later this month, under Apache 2.0. The scores on the page are the vendor’s own numbers and were not re-run here.

highlights.text: 官方称：稀疏混合专家，总参数 5010 亿、每次启用 230 亿，面向写代码、推理和让助手干活。模型本身只处理文字；图片或别的材料要先变成文字它才能用。现在还不能下载。博文写正在做最后的安全测试，提前试用只是登记；权重、技术报告、模型卡和开发者配套「这个月晚些时候」放出，许可打算用 Apache 2.0。
highlights.textEn: Vendor claim: a sparse mixture-of-experts model, 501 billion parameters total and 23 billion active, built for coding, reasoning, and agent work. The model itself is text-only; images or other material have to be turned into text first. It is not downloadable yet. The post says final safety testing is still underway and early access is a signup. Weights, the technical report, the model card, and developer extras are promised later this month, under Apache 2.0.

highlights.text: 官方表格（本库未复跑，NR 表示对方没公布）：Beam 一列里 DeepSWE v1.1 为 44.4，Terminal Bench v2.1 为 80.1，SWE Bench Pro v1 为 65.5，SWEBench Verified 为 80.9，不用工具的 HLE 为 36.2，GPQA Diamond 为 90.5。正文另称：在更难的推理测试上，分数和 GLM-5.2 差不多，推理计算量大约少 3 到 4 倍。这是厂商比较，不是本库测出来的名次。
highlights.textEn: Vendor table (not re-run here; NR means the other lab did not publish a score). In the Beam column: DeepSWE v1.1 44.4, Terminal Bench v2.1 80.1, SWE Bench Pro v1 65.5, SWEBench Verified 80.9, HLE with no tools 36.2, GPQA Diamond 90.5. The prose also says that on harder reasoning tests the scores are comparable to GLM-5.2 at about 3–4× less inference compute. That comparison is the vendor’s, not a ranking produced here.

highlights.text: 官方称：预训练用了 23.8 万亿 token（文本切成的小段），在 6144 张 NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 上不到四周跑完。强化学习用 1.05 万张 NVIDIA GB300，四周里产生超过 1 亿次尝试，单次上下文最长 256K token；文中写中期训练把可用上下文拉到 100 万 token。这些都是厂商自述，本库没有复现训练。
highlights.textEn: Vendor claim: pretraining used 23.8 trillion tokens and finished in under four weeks on 6,144 NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 GPUs. Reinforcement learning used 10,500 NVIDIA GB300 GPUs, produced more than 100 million rollouts over four weeks, and allowed up to 256K tokens of context; the post says midtraining extends usable context to 1 million tokens. All of that is the vendor’s account. This library did not reproduce the training.

models.qualityNote: 博文写明：仍在最终 red-teaming（安全对抗测试）和评测中；权重、技术报告、模型卡和 developer artifacts 这个月晚些时候才发布，许可写的是 Apache 2.0。所以现在不能当已可下载的开源模型。表格数字、3–4 倍推理计算量、23.8 万亿 token、GPU 数量、1 亿次尝试、256K / 1M 上下文都是厂商自述，本库未复跑、未下权重。与 gemini-4-argon、gpt-6-astra、claude-opus-5-5 互链。

models.summary: kouhxp 开源的 gutsy-0.8b（v0.4）：把 Qwen3.5-0.8B 微调成决策模型，不生成自由文本。你送一段状态（文本或 JSON）和 typed questions（yes/no、choice、score），它为每个选项返回校准概率；choice / score 还带 reject。运行时 gutsy-inference 走 llama.cpp，默认可在普通 CPU 上起本地 HTTP；接口刻意对齐 Jev / System One（`/v1/systemone` 等），现有客户端多半只换 base URL。权重在 Hugging Face kouhxp/gutsy（Q8_0 与 Q4_K_M GGUF），代码与权重 README 写 Apache-2.0。JevBench / 评测表与延迟是作者自测，本库未复跑。同板与 Jev、Laya、Clef、Jeeves、Ollaya 相邻；Cases 已有本机 Jeff 与 Onesie CLI。
models.summaryEn: kouhxp’s open gutsy-0.8b (v0.4) fine-tunes Qwen3.5-0.8B into a decision model that does not generate free text. You send a state (text or JSON) plus typed questions (yes/no, choice, score) and get a calibrated probability for every option; choice / score answers also carry reject. The gutsy-inference runtime uses llama.cpp and can serve a local HTTP API on an ordinary CPU. The API deliberately matches Jev / System One (`/v1/systemone` and related), so many existing clients only need a new base URL. Weights live on Hugging Face kouhxp/gutsy (Q8_0 and Q4_K_M GGUF); README says Apache-2.0 for code and weights. JevBench / eval tables and latency are author self-tests, not re-run here. On this board it sits next to Jev, Laya, Clef, Jeeves, and Ollaya; Cases already lists local Jeff and the Onesie CLI.

models.summary: Anthropic 于 2026-09-22 发布的 Claude 5.5 家族第一款模型。官方页正文称：它在多数工作上达到 Claude Fable 5.1 的水平，按典型负载跑起来比 Opus 5 少 40% 花费；meta description 称它在 agentic coding 与知识工作上领先，且比 Opus 5 少 40% 运行成本。官方价目（每百万 token）：输入 $4、输出 $20（称比 Opus 5 少 20%），cache reads $0.20（对照 Opus 5 的 $0.50，称少 60%），cache writes $5（对照 $6.25）；fast mode 为输入 $8 / 输出 $40，称最高 2.5 倍速度。第三方榜：Artificial Analysis 页面（变体 “Adaptive Reasoning, Max Effort, Default Fallback”）列出 Intelligence Index 58（#1 / 211）、输入 $4.00 / 输出 $20.00、缓存折扣 95%、每任务 $5.98、1M 上下文；速度栏为 N/A。
models.summaryEn: Anthropic’s first model in the Claude 5.5 family, announced 2026-09-22. The page says it performs at the level of Claude Fable 5.1 on most work and costs 40% less to run than Opus 5 on typical workloads; the meta description says it leads in agentic coding and knowledge work and costs 40% less to run than Opus 5. Vendor price table (per 1M tokens): input $4, output $20 (claimed 20% less than Opus 5), cache reads $0.20 (vs Opus 5 at $0.50, claimed 60% less), cache writes $5 (vs $6.25); fast mode is $8 input / $40 output, claimed up to 2.5× speed. Third-party board: the Artificial Analysis page (variant “Adaptive Reasoning, Max Effort, Default Fallback”) lists Intelligence Index 58 (#1 / 211), $4.00 input / $20.00 output, a 95% cache discount, $5.98 per task, and a 1M context; the speed cell is N/A.

The platform model id is written claude-opus-5-5, and the page says it is available on all platforms, including Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

highlights.text: 作者称：非自回归、基于双向编码器的 System 1 决策模型，单次前向对任意状态（文本、邮件、工单、JSON）输出结构化决策与校准概率，不生成文本。
highlights.textEn: Author claim: a non-autoregressive System 1 decision model built on bidirectional encoders; one forward pass over any state (text, email, ticket, JSON) returns structured decisions with calibrated probabilities — no text generation.

highlights.text: 作者称：三类原语 — choice（从候选字典选一项，返回选项、分布与置信度）、score（按序数评分表定级）、noul（布尔问题，返回校准的 P(true)）。
highlights.textEn: Author claim: three primitives — choice (pick one key from a criteria dictionary, with distribution and confidence), score (place the state on an ordinal rubric), and noul (a boolean question returning calibrated P(true)).
